airspace.en: No site-specific notice was found for this area; before any real flight, check the CAA "Drone Map" app and apply as required.

park.zh: 阿里山國家森林遊樂區

station.note: upper terminus of the main line, 2,216 m

zhaoping.note: opened 14 March 1914; the largest log collection centre of the Japanese era

xianglin.note: red cypress, 45 m, about 2,300 years old

shenmu.note: site of the first Sacred Tree, felled in 1998

shouzhen.note: largest temple in the area, rebuilt 1969

eco.note: in the former Alishan forestry station

plum.note: plum and cherry trees, mostly Yoshino cherry

datashan.note: highest point of the Alishan Range, 2,663 m (Wikidata Q10934654)

tefuye.note: former Tsou hunting path, later the Shuishan logging line

fenqihu.note: station on the main line, opened 1 October 1912

tagline.zh-Hant: 從1900年的測量到2024年全線復駛：阿里山的一百多年
tagline.en: From the 1900 survey to the full reopening of 2024: a century and more on Alishan

zh: 這裡是嘉義縣阿里山鄉的阿里山，
海拔兩千多公尺的森林遊樂區。
en: This is Alishan in Chiayi County,
a forest recreation area more than 2,000 metres up.

zh: 這片山區原本是鄒族的土地。
en: These mountains were first settled by the Tsou people.

zh: 日本統治臺灣之後，
探勘隊在這裡發現大片檜木林。
en: After Japan took Taiwan,
expeditions found large stands of cypress here.

zh: 1900年開始測量，1906年藤田組動工，
1908年因經費與地形而放棄。
en: Surveying began in 1900; the Fujita company started building in 1906
and gave up in 1908 over money and terrain.

zh: 1910年政府接手，1912年通車；
奮起湖站就在這一年啟用。
en: The government resumed work in 1910 and the line opened in 1912;
Fenqihu station opened that year.

zh: 1914年，沼平車站啟用，
這裡成了日治時期最大的集材中心。
en: Zhaoping station opened in 1914
and became the largest log collection centre of the Japanese era.

zh: 1906年，日本人在這裡發現一棵紅檜巨木，
後來被稱為阿里山神木。
en: In 1906 the Japanese found a giant red cypress here,
later known as the Alishan Sacred Tree.

zh: 這棵樹樹齡超過三千年、高五十二公尺，
1998年因雷擊與豪雨枯萎而放倒。
en: More than 3,000 years old and 52 metres tall,
it withered after lightning and heavy rain and was felled in 1998.

zh: 2006年，民眾票選出第二代神木：
四十五公尺高的香林神木。
en: In 2006 a public vote chose its successor:
the 45-metre Xianglin Sacred Tree.

zh: 伐木持續到1970年代，
森林資源耗盡之後，觀光取代了林業。
en: Logging went on into the 1970s;
once the forest was exhausted, tourism took its place.

zh: 1982年阿里山公路完工，
1986年，看日出的祝山線通車。
en: The Alishan Highway was completed in 1982,
and in 1986 the Zhushan line opened for sunrise trains.

zh: 祝山線是第一段由臺灣自己興建的登山鐵路。
en: The Zhushan branch was the first stretch of mountain railway built by Taiwan itself.

zh: 2009年莫拉克颱風重創鐵路，
直到2024年7月才全線恢復通車。
en: Typhoon Morakot badly damaged the line in 2009;
it fully reopened only in July 2024.

zh: 這條鐵路，被文化部列為臺灣的世界遺產潛力點。
en: Taiwan's Ministry of Culture lists the railway as a potential World Heritage site.

title.en: Sunrise, Sacred Trees and the Mountain of the Tsou

tagline.zh-Hant: 看日出的車站、鄒族的古道與山上的廟
tagline.en: A sunrise station, a Tsou trail and the temple on the mountain

zh: 祝山車站海拔2,451公尺，
是臺灣目前營運中最高的火車站。
en: Zhushan station, at 2,451 metres,
is the highest railway station now operating in Taiwan.

zh: 清晨的列車把人載上來，
為的是看太陽從玉山那一側升起。
en: Early trains bring people up
to watch the sun rise over Jade Mountain.

zh: 森林鐵路、神木、雲海、日出與晚霞，
被稱為阿里山「五奇」。
en: The forest railway, giant trees, sea of clouds, sunrise and sunset glow
are known as Alishan's five wonders.

zh: 在漢人與日本人之前，
這片山區是鄒族的家園。
en: Before Han settlers and the Japanese,
these mountains were home to the Tsou.

zh: 達邦，是今天山區裡的鄒族部落之一。
en: Dabang is one of the Tsou villages in these mountains today.

zh: 特富野古道原是鄒族的獵徑，
也是通婚、探親走的路。
en: The Tefuye trail began as a Tsou hunting path,
also walked for marriages and family visits.

zh: 日治時期，古道後段改建成
運送木材的水山線鐵路。
en: In the Japanese era its upper section
became the Shuishan logging railway.

zh: 回到遊樂區裡，
最大的廟是受鎮宮。
en: Back inside the recreation area,
the largest temple is Shouzhen Temple.

zh: 受鎮宮在1969年改建，供奉玄天上帝，
是當地人的信仰中心。
en: Rebuilt in 1969 and dedicated to Xuantian Shangdi,
it is the centre of local worship.

zh: 姊妹潭是一大一小兩座相鄰的高山湖泊，
傳說有一對姊妹在此殉情。
en: The Sister Ponds are two neighbouring mountain pools, one large, one small;
legend says two sisters died here for love.

zh: 春天，梅園一帶開滿櫻花，
其中以吉野櫻最多。
en: In spring the Plum Garden area fills with cherry blossom,
mostly Yoshino cherry.

zh: 2014年，阿里山國家風景區
有276萬人次到訪。
en: In 2014 the Alishan National Scenic Area
received 2.76 million visits.

zh: 這片山區也以高山茶和山葵聞名。
en: The area is also known for high-mountain tea and wasabi.

zh: 鄒族的山、伐木的山、看日出的山，
都是同一座阿里山。
en: The Tsou's mountain, the loggers' mountain and the sunrise mountain
are one and the same Alishan.

title.en: Red Cypress, Mist and Three Kinds of Forest

tagline.zh-Hant: 一年下雨一百六十天的山上，長著什麼
tagline.en: What grows on a mountain where it rains 160 days a year

zh: 阿里山國家森林遊樂區，
面積約一千四百公頃。
en: The Alishan National Forest Recreation Area
covers about 1,400 hectares.

zh: 這裡年雨量將近四千公釐，
一年有一百六十多天下雨。
en: Nearly 4,000 millimetres of rain fall here each year,
on more than 160 days.

zh: 年平均相對濕度百分之八十六，
雲霧是森林日常的一部分。
en: Relative humidity averages 86 per cent;
cloud and mist are part of the forest's daily life.

zh: 森林鐵路從海拔30公尺爬到2,216公尺，
沿途經過熱帶、暖帶、溫帶三種林相。
en: The forest railway climbs from 30 to 2,216 metres
through tropical, warm-temperate and temperate forest.

zh: 紅檜與臺灣扁柏，
是這裡最主要的兩種檜木。
en: Taiwan red cypress and Taiwan yellow cypress
are the two main cypresses here.

zh: 香林神木是紅檜，高四十五公尺、
樹圍12.3公尺，樹齡約兩千三百年。
en: The Xianglin Sacred Tree is a red cypress 45 metres tall
and 12.3 metres around, about 2,300 years old.

zh: 伐木之後，大約還有四十棵紅檜巨木留下來，
就在巨木群棧道旁。
en: About 40 giant red cypresses survived the logging;
they stand beside the giant-tree boardwalks.

zh: 林下長著臺灣一葉蘭等稀有植物。
en: Rare plants such as the Taiwan pleione grow beneath the trees.

zh: 這裡有臺灣獼猴、帝雉、黃胸藪眉、
栗背林鴝與阿里山山椒魚。
en: Formosan macaque, Mikado pheasant, Steere's liocichla,
collared bush robin and the Alishan salamander live here.

zh: 北邊的大塔山海拔2,663公尺，
是阿里山山脈的最高點。
en: Datashan to the north, 2,663 metres,
is the highest point of the Alishan Range.

zh: 阿里山榆，是只長在阿里山地區的一種榆樹。
en: Ulmus uyematsui, an elm, is found only in the Alishan region.

zh: 舊的阿里山工作站，
現在改成了生態教育館。
en: The old Alishan forestry station
is now an eco-education centre.

zh: 春天，櫻花與杜鵑在林間開放。
en: In spring, cherry blossom and rhododendron flower among the trees.

zh: 被砍伐過的山，
如今重新長成一片森林。
en: A mountain once logged
has grown back into forest.

title.en: Up Two Thousand Metres from the Plain

tagline.zh-Hant: 阿里山山脈的高度、氣候，與一條爬山的窄軌鐵路
tagline.en: The height and climate of the Alishan Range, and a narrow-gauge line that climbs it

zh: 這裡是阿里山山脈，
平均高度約兩千五百公尺。
en: This is the Alishan Range,
about 2,500 metres high on average.

zh: 山脈裡有二十五座山峰超過兩千公尺。
en: Twenty-five of its peaks rise above 2,000 metres.

zh: 遊樂區的入口在臺18線88.2公里處，
海拔2,216公尺。
en: The entrance to the recreation area, at the 88.2 km mark of Highway 18,
is 2,216 metres above sea level.

zh: 要把木材運下山，
鐵路得從海拔30公尺的嘉義一路爬上來。
en: To bring the timber down,
the railway had to climb all the way from Chiayi at 30 metres.

zh: 鐵路採用762公釐的窄軌。
en: The line uses a narrow gauge of 762 millimetres.

zh: 全線有五十多座隧道、
七十七座木橋。
en: It has more than 50 tunnels
and 77 wooden bridges.

zh: 途中在獨立山繞了一段螺旋，再用之字形折返爬升，
最大坡度百分之6.26。
en: On the way it loops in a spiral at Dulishan, then zigzags up through switchbacks;
the steepest gradient is 6.26 per cent.

zh: 主線之外還有支線：
沼平線長1.3公里。
en: Beyond the main line there are branches:
the Zhaoping line is 1.3 kilometres long.

zh: 眠月線在1999年921地震後停駛，
現在成了登山步道。
en: The Mianyue line closed after the 1999 earthquake
and is now a mountain trail.

zh: 從祝山往東看，
大約十四公里外就是玉山。
en: Looking east from Zhushan,
Jade Mountain stands about 14 kilometres away.

zh: 玉山主峰海拔3,952公尺，
比阿里山高出一千多公尺。
en: The main peak of Yushan, 3,952 metres,
stands more than 1,000 metres higher than Alishan.

zh: 阿里山年均溫約十度，
高海拔地區冬天偶爾下雪。
en: The yearly mean temperature on Alishan is about 10°C;
snow sometimes falls high up in winter.

zh: 這裡的最低溫紀錄，
是零下11.5度。
en: The lowest temperature recorded here
is minus 11.5°C.

zh: 從平原到雲海之上，
一條窄軌鐵路連起兩千多公尺的落差。
en: From the plain to above the clouds,
one narrow-gauge line joins more than 2,000 metres of height.
